title: Curators
description: Administer collections, such as artwork, collectibles, historic items, or scientific specimens of museums or other institutions. May conduct instructional, research, or public service activities of institution.

tasks.text: Plan and organize the acquisition, storage, and exhibition of collections and related materials, including the selection of exhibition themes and designs, and develop or install exhibit materials.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Routine ordering automatable; human approves purchases

dwas.name: Construct exhibits or parts of exhibits.
Order instructional or library materials or equipment.

tasks.text: Develop and maintain an institution's registration, cataloging, and basic record-keeping systems, using computer databases.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Archival schema drafted; curation judgment human

dwas.name: Develop library or archival databases.

tasks.text: Plan and conduct special research projects in area of interest or expertise.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI researches and synthesizes; human judges relevance

dwas.name: Research topics in area of expertise.

tasks.text: Provide information from the institution's holdings to other curators and to the public.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Public info provision partly automatable; accountability human

dwas.name: Provide information to the general public.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Negotiate and authorize purchase, sale, exchange, or loan of collections.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Routine ordering automatable; human approves purchases

dwas.name: Negotiate purchases or contracts.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

dwas.name: Order instructional or library materials or equipment.

tasks.text: Study, examine, and test acquisitions to authenticate their origin, composition, history, and to assess their current value.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Archival object evaluation needs hands-on examination

dwas.name: Evaluate characteristics of archival or historical objects.

tasks.text: Inspect premises to assess the need for repairs and to ensure that climate and pest control issues are addressed.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical site verification against specs is human

dwas.name: Inspect work sites to determine condition or necessary repairs.
Inspect facilities or sites to determine if they meet specifications or standards.
Inspect condition or functioning of facilities or equipment.

tasks.text: Write and review grant proposals, journal articles, institutional reports, and publicity materials.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Scholarly critique aided; expert judgment owns verdict

dwas.name: Evaluate scholarly materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

dwas.name: Write grant proposals.
Write articles, books or other original materials in area of expertise.

tasks.text: Design, organize, or conduct tours, workshops, and instructional or educational sessions to acquaint individuals with an institution's facilities and materials.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Public programs need community engagement and judgment

dwas.name: Plan community programs or activities for the general public.

tasks.text: Attend meetings, conventions, and civic events to promote use of institution's services, to seek financing, and to maintain community alliances.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Promotional content drafted; human owns institutional relationships

dwas.name: Promote educational institutions or programs.

tasks.text: Train and supervise curatorial, fiscal, technical, research, and clerical staff, as well as volunteers or interns.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Staff training is relational and accountability-bearing

dwas.name: Train staff members.
Direct activities of subordinates.

tasks.text: Confer with the board of directors to formulate and interpret policies, to determine budget requirements, and to plan overall operations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Arranging operations requires live human negotiation

dwas.name: Confer with others to conduct or arrange operational activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Arrange insurance coverage for objects on loan or for special exhibits and recommend changes in coverage for the entire collection.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Coverage arranged via systems; judgment and liability human

dwas.name: Arrange insurance coverage.

tasks.text: Schedule events and organize details, including refreshment, entertainment, decorations, and the collection of any fees.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Public programs need community engagement and judgment

dwas.name: Plan community programs or activities for the general public.

tasks.text: Establish specifications for reproductions and oversee their manufacture or select items from commercially available replica sources.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.
